title: Versioned checkpoint, migration, integrity, and evidence ownership
objective: Make an exact checkpoint the canonical resume source and fail closed once a session opts into the protocol.
requirements: Content-address checkpoint files by full transcript digest and validate an envelope checksum.
Use a capability manifest, bounded private files, atomic publication, directory fsync, identity checks, and evidence manifest validation.
Materialize all reachable evidence and copy it into fork ownership.
Migrate v2 explicitly to v3 without claiming that unrecorded cursor/aggregate/action state was exact.
acceptance: fork evidence remains readable after source deletion
result: Checkpoint v3, capability manifest, checksum, secure I/O, explicit v2 bridge, evidence materialization, and independent fork evidence are implemented.
